en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3265 - Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) that he said:

"It is the duty of the Imam to bring out those imprisoned for debt on Fridays and for Eid prayers. He should send someone to accompany them, and once they have completed the prayer and the Eid rituals, they should be returned to prison."
